articles.title: Brampton man in life-threatening condition following road rage incident in Orangeville
articles.summary: A 44-year-old Brampton man is in life-threatening condition following a road rage incident in Orangeville.

articles.title: Two elderly people critically injured in multi-vehicle crash in Scarborough
articles.summary: Two elderly people have been critically injured following a multi-vehicle crash in Scarborough.

articles.title: Man wanted for unprovoked attack against demonstrator on Yonge Street
articles.summary: Toronto police are searching for a man after someone was allegedly assaulted during a demonstration in downtown Toronto on Saturday.

articles.title: Cleveland-Cliffs CEO says he's prepared to fight Canada in court over Stelco layoffs
articles.summary: The CEO of the American company that owns Hamilton-based steelmaker Stelco says he's prepared to fight the Canadian government in court over Stelco's plan to lay off hundreds of workers. He also said he's open to selling the company and voiced support for U.S. tariffs on Canadian steel, despite citing tariffs as a reason for the company's economic struggles.

articles.title: 7 food charity trucks out of service after catalytic converters stolen from Etobicoke yard: CEO
articles.summary: A Toronto charity says it is disappointed and outraged after its yard was broken into and catalytic converters were stolen from its food rescue trucks early Sunday.

articles.title: Jamaal Magloire Foundation hosts 6th annual Thanksgiving meal giveaway
articles.summary: The Jamaal Magloire Foundation hosted its sixth annual Thanksgiving meal giveaway on Saturday. The event provided 1,000 meals to families in Scarborough. CBC-Radio Canada caught up with former Canadian basketball player Magloire and some attendees, who spoke about the importance of giving back during the holidays.

articles.title: ‘Outrageous’: 7 trucks from Etobicoke food charity vandalized over Thanksgiving weekend
articles.summary: Local food charity Second Harvest has been left reeling following a devastating act of vandalism over the Thanksgiving long weekend.

articles.title: Brampton man, 35, charged with attempted murder in stabbing investigation
articles.summary: A 35-year-old man facing an attempted murder charge in connection with a stabbing last week in Brampton has turned himself into police

articles.title: Top Toronto mayoral candidates attend food bank’s annual Thanksgiving sort
articles.summary: Hundreds of volunteers, including Toronto’s top mayoral candidates, attended the Daily Bread Food Bank’s annual Thanksgiving food sort in Etobicoke Saturday, ahead of the holiday.

articles.title: South Asian film festival celebrates 15-year milestone in Canada
articles.summary: The International Film Festival of South Asia celebrates 15 years this year. The milestone marks a new chapter for the Peel Region event as it goes from curating worldwide films to building an ecosystem where local South Asian filmmakers can thrive. articles.title: Stelco says Hamilton layoffs still happening despite Ottawa's threats of legal action
articles.summary: Hamilton-based steelmaker Stelco says it will proceed with hundreds of layoffs, despite threats of legal action from the federal government.

articles.title: VIA Rail to continue service at Scarborough's Guildwood station
articles.summary: VIA Rail has reversed its decision to discontinue train service at Scarborough’s Guildwood station. The move comes after intense pushback from the community and government officials. CBC’s Tyler Cheese has the details and reaction.

articles.title: Truck driver dies at Vaughan warehouse, Ontario Labour Ministry investigating
articles.summary: The Ontario Ministry of Labour is investigating an industrial accident after a truck driver died in Vaughan on Friday.

articles.title: Police release video of vehicles in area before fatal hit and run in Vaughan
articles.summary: Police have released new video of three vehicles in the area where a woman was fatally struck in a Vaughan hit and run on the weekend, saying they're hoping to speak to the drivers.
